security_key.intro_primary: The security key encrypts and protects your encryption keys. If you log in on another device or lose your keys, you can use the security key to recover your encrypted data.
security_key.intro_warning: Please keep your security key safe. You will not be able to recover encrypted data if you lose it!
security_key.passphrase_desc: Enter a memorable but hard-to-guess passphrase as your security key
security_key.passphrase_too_short: Passphrase must be at least 8 characters
security_key.key_warning: Save this key in a safe place and do not share it with anyone
security_key.passphrase_warning: Remember this passphrase. You will not be able to recover encrypted data if you lose it
security_key.key_saved_confirm: I have safely saved the key
security_key.verify_prompt: Please enter your saved security key to confirm
security_key.verify_passphrase_prompt: Please enter your passphrase to confirm
security_key.success_desc: Your encryption keys are now protected by the security key. Keep your security key safe to recover encrypted data on new devices.

onboarding.welcome_desc: End-to-end encryption protects your messages. Once set up, your messages can only be read by you and your conversation participants.
onboarding.key_warning: Save this key in a safe place and do not share it with anyone
onboarding.key_saved_confirm: I have safely saved the key
onboarding.save_key_warning: Please save the security key before continuing
onboarding.complete_desc: Your messages are now protected by end-to-end encryption.
